title: Graded face lifts and free extreme points of free spectrahedra
summary: A free spectrahedron is the matricial solution set of a free linear matrix inequality $L_A(X) = I-A_1 \otimes X_1 - \dots - A_g \otimes X_g \succeq 0$. In this dimension-free setting, free extreme points play the role of classical extreme points. In particular, every bounded real free spectrahedron is the matrix convex hull of its free extreme points. In this qualitative sense, free extreme points of free spectrahedra are abundant.
